resumos: A data structure used in search engines to map terms to documents, foundational for keyword-based search systems.
The fundamental data structure used by full-text search engines to map keywords to document locations.
Estrutura de dados fundamental que mapeia palavras aos documentos onde elas aparecem para buscas rápidas.
The fundamental data structure used for keyword search to map words to their locations in documents.
